tensions.title: JSON-file persistence vs D-01 MongoDB per-tenant
tensions.on_disk_finding: M9 platform layer 36 modules are frozen dataclasses with zero persistence. Northena ledger writes to filesystem JSON at phase0/northena_ledger/led-<hex12>.json. Memory ledger also filesystem-based. Only auth/user_store.py uses Motor Mongo (users only).
tensions.v1_mandate: D-01: MongoDB primary datastore, one DB per tenant (t_<tenant_id>) + one platform DB

tensions.title: Preventive-charter refusals vs mandated unroutable runtime chokepoint enforcement
tensions.on_disk_finding: LLM chokepoint (chokepoint/llm.py 491 LOC + AST negative-scan) IS a real unroutable chokepoint. M9 platform layer refusals are shape-only wrappers — no ASGI middleware / FastAPI Depends binding routes any tenant request through them.
tensions.v1_mandate: A.3/A.4: enforcement happens at chokepoints that cannot be routed around
tensions.verdict: split: LLM chokepoint DONE, M9 refusers PARTIAL

tensions.title: The Ledger (hash-chained single-writer verifier) vs current seals/audit_event
tensions.on_disk_finding: Multiple ledger-flavoured writers (northena, memory, audit_trail, platform_control_plane/audit_event.py) exist. None implements SHA256(prev_hash||canonical(row)) single-writer with independent verifier binary per B.4. Phase0 seals are TCB-audit artefacts, not tenant-facing Ledger.
tensions.v1_mandate: B.4 + C.4: single Ledger writer consumes intents in order, computes hash chain, independent verifier recomputes nightly per tenant

tensions.title: Frontends absent vs two rich prototypes provided
tensions.on_disk_finding: Both DAP + RMS AI Prototype v2 exist only as standalone HTML/JS blobs. Zero React/Expo implementations in any repo. Extraction-Akki frontend/src/pages/ has internal Akki tool surfaces (Auth, CanonOSShell, connect, govern, master_admin, memory, prove, registry, team, trace, use_data) but no consumer/analyst surfaces.

tensions.title: CONTRACT-MODELED infra items still not real
tensions.on_disk_finding: No K8s manifests / MIG code / SAML federation / Ed25519 KMS / Kafka log / S3 abstraction / vector store on disk
tensions.v1_mandate: D-04..D-10 (Kubernetes, K8s MIG, identity federation, KMS, Kafka log, vector store)

tensions.title: TCB regime vs current thin-kernel invariants
tensions.on_disk_finding: Overlaps: chokepoint/llm.py AST negative-scan (real) + 4809 pytest invariants + doc0_attributes/tcb.py + phase0 seal chain + STANDING_ORDERS §7 R-1..R-5. Missing: repo-root TCB.yaml, global akki.arch CI import-assertions, determinism byte-identical golden-input corpus, 2-reviewer tooling enforcement.
tensions.v1_mandate: B.8: TCB.yaml + import assertions + determinism byte-identical tests + 2-reviewer

tensions.title: B.1 principals (5) vs M9 roles (7) — reconcile
tensions.on_disk_finding: B.1 principals = platform_operator/user/service_account/data_plane_agent/external_party (identity axis). M9 P2-CP1 roles = platform_operator/tenant_owner/tenant_admin/data_steward/analyst/viewer/service (RBAC axis). Different axes; they compose. New in v1.0: data_plane_agent + external_party carriers not modelled by M9.
tensions.verdict: not a contradiction — different axes; 2 new principal carriers needed

tensions.title: Annex D v0.2 → v1.0 normative deltas invalidating M9?
tensions.on_disk_finding: Zero sealed M9 CP is invalidated by any v1.0 delta. Every M9 shape carrier remains correct-in-shape at 4809. Deltas Δ-1..Δ-7 add new work downstream but do not require rework of sealed CPs.
tensions.verdict: no rework of sealed M9 work
